    A little luck. A little strategy. A lot of picking up.

    The fine art of
    getting rid of cards.

    Be the first to play every card. The player left holding cards is the Shithead.

    Before you start

    Each player gets 3 cards in hand, 3 face up and 3 face down. Swap your hand and face-up cards to save your best cards for later. You open the game.

    On your turn

    Play a card equal to or higher than the top card, or play a matching set. Draw back up to 3 while the deck has cards. If you can't play, pick up the pile; your turn ends. You may also choose to pick it up.

    2 · Always playable
    Put a 2 on anything. It does not reset the pile or cancel stacked sevens. It uses one low turn.
    3 · Reverse
    Changes direction. In this two-player game, you play again. A 3 must still be a legal play.
    7 · Low cards
    The next play must be 7 or lower. Each additional 7 adds a low turn. A normal low play uses one; jokers preserve the restriction.
    10 · Burn
    Always playable. Removes the entire pile and its restrictions. Play again.
    Joker · Transparent
    Always playable. The card underneath still sets the rank to beat. Does not use a low turn.
    Four of a kind · Burn
    Four matching cards consecutively on the pile burn it. Play again.

    The last stretch

    Once the deck and your hand are empty, play your face-up cards. Then choose a face-down card without looking. If it can't be played, pick it up with the pile and work through your hand again. First to empty all three zones wins.

    A fresh deal?

    Your current game will be replaced. Your running score stays.
